title: SecurityUpdateRecord
description: DERIVED from distilled/messages.yaml (§5.4.1); the EN defines no schema and no encoding. Security updates and patches, their notification and delivery, and the contingency where none can be provided.

update_or_patch.description: the security update or patch provided

notified_system_operators.description: System Operators notified of the update
notified_system_operators.x-condition: where an update or patch is provided

delivered_to_end_users.description: System Operator delivered the update to End-users
delivered_to_end_users.x-condition: where an update or patch is provided

contingency_mechanisms.description: mechanisms and contingency plans to mitigate security risks, particularly where updates cannot be provided

major_update_retested.description: a major update was treated as a new model version with new security testing and evaluation

operator_support_mechanisms.description: support to System Operators to evaluate and respond to model changes, e.g. beta-testing preview access and versioned APIs
